config.signalscope.title: Signalscope settings
config.signalscope.stable_angle.descript: Maximum angle for stable reception. Must be smaller than the reception angle.
config.signalscope.reception_angle.descr: Angle for visual tracking. Sound fades to zero within the first third of the range beyond the stable angle.
config.signalscope.voice_volume.descript: Maximum voice and passive signal volume at stable reception.
config.signalscope.hud_scale.description: Size of the mod's rings, names and messages, independent of Minecraft's GUI Scale. Default: 100%, equivalent to GUI Scale 5.
config.signalscope.max_nicknames.descrip: Maximum number of player rows shown on the HUD, if space permits.
config.signalscope.radio_mode.descriptio: Hold the use button or press it once to toggle transmission.
